comments.value:
I agree with this--at least have an option for it. I do like having the yellow outline elsewhere (helps with very far friend finding), but we should have an option to re-enable yellow friend names in the UI.

In addition, I always liked having "clean" nameplates, where I only had people's nameplates and banners showing. The friend outline kills that option for me.

I love the new nameplates. The yellow outline is on friends is my only complaint.

1.) It makes it harder to tell when friends are talking because it always lights up regardless when the blue doesn't show when not talking.

2.) 0% Transparency name-tags show the outline all the time which seems to defeat the point of them being transparent.

I've already had multiple instances of having trouble finding friends in crowded instances due to how easy it is to miss the yellow outline. When I have noticed it, it's because the bright color is clashing badly with the environment compared compared to having yellow text surrounded by a nameplate whose border is a more cool neutral color like the live version's blue.

Would appreciate having yellow names as an accessibility option at least.
